mentions.story: Lithium battery costs have fallen by 98% in three decades
mentions.why: Argues solar, wind and batteries are cheapest and getting cheaper every year.
mentions.quote: Solar and wind-power can compete very efficiently in a free market. They actually outperform all other forms of energy-production (it is the cheapest way to produce energy). Also every year they get much cheaper. I would recommend this video: [VIDEO]
